serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Landlord: Finally someone decided to open the door. You: What’s the matter? It’s late. Landlord: Uh~ It’s late~{{wi}} Stop complaining! Landlord: My informant told me that these goddamn leeches from the City Hall planned for tomorrow a surprise fire code inspection in this building! Landlord: Usually they would let me know beforehand, but we had a little disagreement about the size of the bribe- I mean donation. Landlord: I need help to sort this thing out as soon as possible! You: Why do I need to help you? It seems like your problem. Landlord: Oh, you little! {{punch}} Landlord: You live under my roof for years and this one time that I need help, you dare to turn your back on me?! You: W-Well, it’s true that I’m staying here, but I’m paying you for it. Landlord: Fine! Do whatever you want! But don’t blame me when they close this place up and force you to move out! You: What? Landlord: You heard me! This place is in ruin! If they make an honest inspection, they might even put a yellow tape around it! Fuck this… {{wi}}It seems like I have no choice and need to help this piece of shit. It’s better than being homeless. You: Fine, I will do it. What do you need? Landlord: That’s the spirit! Landlord: Here’s the to-do list. You: ‘Buy 50 9-volt batteries and put them in smoke detectors’?! Landlord: It might be a little much, but I figured that at least half of the old batteries had to die since the last time I changed them was like 5 years ago. You: Alright, 50 batteries. What else is here… You: ‘Fix the leaking pipe with tape from the tv commercial’... {{wi}}Really? Landlord: It’s just for the inspection! I will hire a repairman later! Besides, it’s only a minor gas leak. You: It’s a gas leak?! Landlord: Minor gas leak! Minor! Tape will do! It worked the last time! You: Have it your way, what else… You: ‘Change service dates on fire extinguishers’... You: Change? Shouldn’t you replace them? Landlord: Replacing them every year is an extortion! No one’s been using them, so they should be full anyway. You: I don’t think that’s how it works… You: Next is… You: ‘Screw in bulbs on the fire exit signs.’ Landlord: Electricity went up again this year. Everyone is looking for ways to save money, not just me. Landlord: That was the last one if I remember correctly. I’m sure you will figure things out. You: Wait, you are leaving me with all of this?! Landlord: I have other buildings to take care of! Stop being selfish and think about all the other people that might end up on the streets! You: … Landlord: So, now that you know what to do, I will be going. Good luck!
